privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: AEP Downgrader works on this computer. Your files are never uploaded, and there is no account and no telemetry. The app goes online only to check for updates (you can turn this off above) and to download an update when you click Update.

problemHint.not-ae-file: AEP Downgrader works with .aep, .aet and .ffx files saved by After Effects.
problemHint.sidecar: macOS creates these next to files on some drives. You can ignore it.
problemHint.xml-project: Open it in After Effects, save it as .aep and convert that file.
problemHint.truncated: The file ends too early: it may not have finished copying or downloading.
problemHint.damaged: Try a backup or an auto-saved version of the project.
problemHint.too-new: Check for an update of the app.
problemHint.unreadable: Check that the file isn’t open in another app and that you have access to it.
